spellbook.finance/limitations: This changes public marketplace behavior for the whole workspace. It is not a preview, and nothing asks the seller again before SpellBook acts on the new mode.
Only the workspace owner may call it. An admin or member gets delegated_agent_workspace_owner_required.
Set a mode only after the seller chose it in their own words. Never pick one for them, and never read silence as a choice. A lane starts off.

observe and push answer 403 channel_lane_feature_disabled while the marketplace's feature flag is off for the seller, and 409 channel_lane_sync_not_built when SpellBook has no sync for the marketplace. off always saves.

push answers agent_marketplace_publish_disabled while SpellBook has agent marketplace writes switched off, the switch that also governs spellbook_ebay_publish. off and observe always save, so an agent can always stop a lane. Switching agent marketplace writes off later does not stop a push lane an agent set earlier, so set the lane to off to stop it.

push on a marketplace with open bids can sell a card at once when SpellBook's ask sits at or below a bid. The response carries lane.agreementRate and lane.observeAgreeCount for the observe period, and both are null or zero when the lane has not observed anything.

Turning a lane on from off queues planning for the card copies the workspace already holds. Planning runs after the response returns, so the lane counts in the response can leave those copies out. Changing observe to push queues no new planning.

Planning records target quantities for those copies and creates no listing. lane.dirtyListings counts targets the marketplace has not confirmed yet, and a push does not prove a buyer can see a listing.

description: Set one workspace's lane mode for one channel-lane marketplace, the switch that decides whether SpellBook reads the marketplace or changes listings there. This changes public marketplace behavior for the workspace, only the workspace owner may call it, and the agent sets a mode only after the seller chose one. It returns the same lane state as spellbook_marketplace_onboarding. The modes: off: the lane is disabled and SpellBook neither reads nor changes the marketplace. observe: SpellBook reads the marketplace and records whether it matches SpellBook's desired state, and never changes a listing there. push: SpellBook creates, updates, and removes listings on the marketplace to match its desired state.

marketplace.description: The channel-lane marketplace whose mode to set. Required.

mode.description: The mode the seller chose: off, observe, or push. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose lane to set. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_channel_lane_set
